en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

Shooting, editing and English copy: Supported 50 Instagram posts through topic planning, shooting, editing and English copywriting; organized hashtags, promotional assets and publishing schedules for online product communication.
Product messaging: Researched ZUS Coffee launches using audience preferences, social interactions and competitor content to identify product messages and consumption scenarios.

Publishing and content reviews: Supported the online launch and FamilyMart communication with store details and promotional assets. Tracked performance weekly and delivered 15+ content reviews, contributing to 11k+ account follower growth.

WeChat account from scratch: Turned AI education features, instructions and use cases into accessible content, delivering 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and cases. Built reusable materials; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.

User research: Managed university communities and classified 100+ feedback items across teaching, lesson preparation and self-study to inform product messaging, content topics and promotional materials.

Product cases and university outreach: Worked with product and business teams on demos, teaching cases, FAQs and course materials for university presentations, trials and Q&A. Consolidated feedback into 10 recommendations supporting pilots and product improvements.
Southeast Asia partnership follow-up: Organized partner needs, responsibilities and handoff details and followed up on agreement signing and project handoff for an AI education product.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.
Content planning: Produced 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts around AI features, use cases and recurring questions. Used user feedback and pricing surveys to refine messages and topics.

Visual materials and creators: Supported promotional assets and publishing, checked copy and visual presentation for brand consistency, and screened creators by audience fit, content relevance and engagement.
AI-assisted operations analysis: Built a lightweight AI-assisted dashboard to track core metrics and combined data with feedback to adjust promotion timing.

Communication reviews: Tested titles, covers and content across Xiaohongshu, WeChat, technology events and communities. Campaign registrations increased 50% versus the prior week and first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: 2027 Master of Marketing candidate with working English and experience in AI product content, WeChat account development, visual and video production and communication reviews.
Content: product messaging, social topics, promotional copy, use cases, materials and creator collaboration.
AI production: assisted copy ideation, creative concepts, dashboards and analysis; SOPs, checklists and reusable templates for content workflows.
Data: Excel, SPSS, SQL (basic); title and cover tests, channel monitoring and content reviews.
Visual and content tools: WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Instagram; Canva, CapCut and Figma (basic).
